summary: ExchangeRight Income Fund, a Maryland REIT and general partner of its operating partnership, filed an 8-K disclosing an October 2, 2026 amendment to the partnership agreement creating a new Class T Common Unit class. The units are being issued as consideration to acquire a net-leased property, with a fixed annual distribution of $1.650691 per unit paid monthly, corresponding to the Company's Class D Common Shares. The amendment was approved by the Company as general partner and required no limited partner approval. Deal pricing, property identity, and seller terms were not disclosed; watch for the property acquisition 8-K, valuation of units issued, and distribution-rate adjustment mechanics.
